relation: required tasks start from one fork, progress independently, and release one downstream result only after every task has completed and docked at the same join barrier

stageEvents.observable: one start signal fans out to three required task lanes
all required tasks are visibly in progress at the same time
an early completion waits at the join while unfinished tasks continue
the final required completion changes the barrier count to three of three and unlocks the gate
one downstream result is released only after the barrier is satisfied

limits: two to four required tasks with unique stable IDs
all tasks begin from one declared fork and may complete at different times
each task contributes exactly one completion token to the join barrier
completed tasks remain visibly waiting while unfinished tasks continue
the downstream result remains blocked until every declared required task is complete
no factor-causation, condition branch, weighted contribution, optional task, retry loop, or post-join branch claim
